exercises.instruction_verbatim: The shopkeeper has written down the number of fruits. 1. Can you guess why there are two numbers on each basket? 2. What is different about both numbers?
exercises.answer_key: Conceptual/discussion, no single fixed answer — this previews rounding: the first number on each basket is the exact/actual count of fruit; the number in brackets is that count rounded off to the nearest ten (a simpler, close approximation). The two numbers differ because one is exact and one is rounded.
exercises.answer_confidence: high (conceptual framing, matches Topic 3 'Rounding Off' that follows)
